text: This report seeks Council's authority for the adoption of the necessary by-law to designate the premises occupied by the City of Toronto at 481 University Avenue as a municipal capital facility for the portion of premises occupied by staff of City Planning and Children's Services, and to provide a property tax exemption for municipal and education purposes. The municipal capital facility agreement will provide an exemption for approximately 14,445 square feet (1,342 square metres) of interior space, which is the entire 6th floor of 481 University Avenue.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council pass a by-law pursuant to Section 252 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, providing authority to: a. enter into a municipal capital facility agreement with 481 Uni Investments Inc., owners of the property known as 481 University Avenue, or its successors or assigns, with respect to approximately 14,445 square feet (1,342 square metres) of rentable area (the "Leased Premises") leased by the City of Toronto for the purposes of providing a municipal capital facility used for the general administration of the City; and b. exempt the Leased Premises from taxation for municipal and school purposes, which tax exemption is to be effective from the latest of: i. the commencement date of the Lease; ii. the date the municipal capital facility agreement is entered into; and iii. the date the tax exemption by-law is…
